applicability: FMEA Risk Priority Number from declared Severity/Occurrence/Detection ratings, checked against a declared maximum acceptable value
assumptions: each rating was assigned consistently against the same 1-10 scale definition
RPN is used only as a sorting/prioritization aid, not the sole release-approval criterion
uncertainty: Standard, foundational reliability-engineering method (AIAG-VDA FMEA handbook); hand-verified before use (S=8,O=5,D=3 -> RPN=120; S=10,O=10,D=10 -> RPN=1000).
limits_policy: An RPN exceeding the declared maximum acceptable value is flagged rather than accepted.
